title: PPT Master benchmark run record
description: One P0 benchmark case's measured metrics. Enforced by hand-written checks in scripts/benchmark_report.py, following this repository's convention of treating JSON Schema files as a documented contract rather than a runtime validation-engine dependency (no generic JSON-Schema engine is used anywhere in this Skill).

case_id.description: Matches one row's id in references/benchmarking/corpus.md

notes.description: Any deviation from the case's recorded instruction in corpus.md

input_tokens.description: Not derivable from repo files; read from the host's own usage reporting

output_tokens.description: Not derivable from repo files; read from the host's own usage reporting

wall_clock_seconds.description: benchmark-end minus benchmark-start NOTE timestamps in validation/workflow.log

tool_call_count.description: Count of 'PYTHON run=<id>' envelopes between the markers; undercounts non-Python tool calls

time_to_first_slide_seconds.description: mtime of the first svg_output/*.svg (sorted lexicographically) minus benchmark-start

total_build_seconds.description: Same as wall_clock_seconds; kept as a distinct field to match the source spec's metrics table

rework_count.description: Extra svg_quality_checker.py invocations per stage beyond the first pass

resume_success.description: Always N/A for a P0 baseline record; P1 (Persistent Build State) does not exist yet at baseline time
